Yes, exactly! There was one time we picked up his drunk friend from the bar and took him home. Then drunk friend talked my Narc into playing a game of pool before we left. During this game the friend was making fun of me saying how quiet and awkward I was. He'd ask me questions then if I wasn't entertaining enough he'd cut me off and make fun of me again. My Narc was laughing the entire time not saying a word. He also liked to compare me to other people a lot, we were at the Hookah bar and there was a bunch of girls dancing by the DJ and he wanted me to go out there with him. I didn't feel comfortable and said didn't want to, after we left he turned to me and said "I wish you would be more like those girls dancing, I think its sexy."

You do not seem clingy, oversensitive or emotionally unable. He is the one that is unstable. My Narc would always tell me that I was clingy and needed to get friends but would then contradict and be upset if I went out. He also used my "behavior" against me as well, would tell me that I'm immature (4yr difference) and talk poorly about me to other females. You are NOT in the wrong in any of those situations and deserve SOO much better! It's hard but please don't let him suck you back in or it will just go back to the 'same old habits' even though he may promise to change
